decisions.name: 1-iso-fractions-baseline
decisions.notes: All 17 effective inputs and complete final diff reviewed. Scoped multi-symbol patch with export header fails safely; symbol replacements recover, then selected 141 tests and root types both actually succeed after final edit. All fractional/invalid/date/context behavior and outside code preserved, independent full suite and both timezone features pass. No no-op or retrieval. finish_task admits satisfied but unverified because these command checks do not create project receipts; distinguish actual passing tests from admitted verification.

Satisfied delivery is technically unverified: actual command checks are distinct from project validation receipts. No body layout mechanism is exercised by this patch.

decisions.name: 1-duration-limit-modified

Correct braced interface/function batch recovers. maxUnits validated before empty/locale returns; emitted accumulator limits after missing/zero selection and preserves duplicate/custom order and inputs. 141 required tests and root types actually pass after last edit; independent full suite and both-zone feature tests pass, only allowed file changed. No no-op or retrieval. Explicit braces appear only after syntax feedback, so do not attribute recovery to upfront description alone.

Selected 141 tests and root types actually pass after last edit; independent full suite and feature tests pass. No large package manifest read, no no-op or solution retrieval. Body layout description is not exercised by these patches.

decisions.name: 1-shared-day-millis-baseline

Actual 141 selected tests and types succeed after final edit. Existing suite passes. Original verifier rejects ten-J output width because it requires exactly eight; request says at least eight, so full request criterion permits ten digits. Preserve frozen functional failure and report separate uniform wording sensitivity; no source recovery or retrieved solution.
